ITEM 1 | Cluster of white florets with compact, bumpy curd-like surfaces and some small green-tinged edges, matte and dry, with stems cut into short pale pieces; spread across the left-center of the plate covering roughly 30% of the plate, about 2-4 cm per floret, piled 2-3 cm high in places | 150
ITEM 2 | Half of a round yellow-orange slice with a pale, fibrous, pitted center and a bright yellow rim, smooth and slightly glossy skin, sitting alone at upper right; about 7 cm across and 3-4 cm thick | 90
ITEM 3 | Orange-salmon cubes and wedges with smooth, slightly moist cut faces showing faint fibers, some with a thin darker peel edge, cut into irregular chunks about 2-4 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, clustered at lower right covering roughly 25% of the plate | 130
